shortIntro.title: Is Your Phone Ready for Injustice Mobile? Let’s Find Out 🦸‍♂️📲
shortIntro.para1: Injustice: Gods Among Us Mobile isn’t just a tap-to-fight game. It’s packed with combos, specials, and epic super moves where even a tiny lag can ruin your timing.
shortIntro.para2: Smooth inputs, instant special moves, and flawless combos all depend on strong hardware. If your phone can’t keep up, you’ll be spectating more than fighting 😅🔥.

faqIntroText: Common Injustice Mobile questions — answered without the rage 😎:

faqList.question: Does Injustice Mobile need a powerful phone?
faqList.answer: Yes. Budget phones run it, but mid-range or better hardware ensures smooth combos and cinematic effects.

faqList.question: Can I run Injustice at 60 FPS?
faqList.answer: Yes, on capable mid-range or flagship phones with high FPS enabled.

faqList.question: Why does Injustice heat my phone?
faqList.answer: Constant action, cinematic moves, and high-quality graphics push your CPU/GPU. Take breaks or cool your phone if needed 😅.
